key_insight: Three data- and gate-informed rules select variational quantum circuit entanglement, depth and readout before training, avoiding an ansatz grid search.
engineering_relevance: The approach guides circuit architecture selection while exposing trade-offs in entanglement, parameter count and measurement information.
method: Use singular value decomposition of data Fourier coefficients to identify entanglement needs and bound the error from omitting it.
Choose depth from quantum Fisher information rank growth and its dynamical Lie algebra ceiling.
Read all 2^N − 1 Pauli-Z products from shared measurement shots to resolve half of the state's directions.
evidence_signal: On Madelon, the prescribed 7 three-qubit blocks at depth 3 yielded a 239-parameter classifier with 78.5% test accuracy; shallower circuits, smaller blocks and removing reuploading reduced accuracy.
watch_item: Although Pauli-Z products share measurement shots, their number grows exponentially with qubit count, creating post-processing and finite-shot estimation concerns.
paper_title: Data informed Ansatz Selection for Variational Quantum Circuits
